args.summary: FX-RAM-01 (fx-latitude-ram, Dell Latitude 7440) has a persistent RAM constraint finding (RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 snapshots on a 16 GB device). However, 128 GB is not an allowed RAM upgrade spec; the allowed options are 16, 32, or 64 GB.

claims.text: Device FX-RAM-01 resolves to device ID FX-RAM-01 (fx-latitude-ram, Dell Latitude 7440, employee emp-fx-1003).
A persistent RAM constraint insight exists for FX-RAM-01: RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 snapshots on a 16 GB device (level: persistent).
Creating a 128 GB RAM upgrade order failed because 128 GB is not an allowed spec; allowed specs are 16, 32, 64 GB.

caveats: One RAM reading per day: high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
